title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population under peer influence, policies, information campaigns, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People update their mask adoption propensity based on the share of their social neighbors who wear masks and norms communicated during interactions.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_location
interactions.description: Locations with mask-required policies gate entry; non-compliant people may be denied entry or fined depending on enforcement strength.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People attempt to buy masks from retailers; purchase succeeds if inventory is available at the prevailing price (minus any subsidies).

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Government and media broadcast messages affecting risk perception and trust; individuals update beliefs weighted by credibility and personal trust.

interactions.name: economic_incentives
interactions.description: Subsidies lower effective price; fines increase expected cost of non-compliance, shifting adoption decisions.

interactions.name: schedule_based_contacts
interactions.description: People visit locations according to schedules (home, work, transit, retail); contacts at locations influence norms and enforcement experiences.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of people wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Days elapsed to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_mandate
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over a window after mandate removal compared to during mandate.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across groups (e.g., age, income, occupation), measured by Gini or variance.

metrics.name: non_compliance_events
metrics.description: Count of denied entries or fines issued due to non-compliance at locations.

metrics.name: supply_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days where demand for masks exceeded retailer inventory.

metrics.name: price_trajectory
metrics.description: Time series of average mask price across retailers.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in mean adoption rates with and without mandate/campaign (counterfactual or pre-post).

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change below 0.5 percentage points for at least 7 consecutive days indicates behavioral steady state.

validation_criteria.name: mass_balance_supply
validation_criteria.description: Total masks sold cannot exceed cumulative supply plus initial inventory across retailers.

validation_criteria.name: mandate_response_check
validation_criteria.description: Under strong enforcement (>=0.8) and moderate fines, adoption should increase by at least 10 percentage points within 14 days of mandate start (sanity check).

validation_criteria.name: bounded_outcomes
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rates must remain within [0,1]; negative inventories and prices are disallowed.
